commentary: Market direction is the ultimate headwind: with Nifty breaching key support at 22,500 on heavy institutional distribution and breadth collapsing to 37%, O'Neil's market discipline dictates maximum defensiveness. Three out of four stocks track the general market; in a hostile tape, progressive exposure and capital preservation override aggressive buying. Stan Weinstein warned against initiating Stage 2 breakouts without market alignment, while Jesse Livermore insisted on never fighting the tape. Even when resilient leaders like AEGISLOG and ALICON demonstrate high relative strength, fresh exposure must remain minimal. Respect the WEAK deterministic gate, enforce Minervini-style risk controls, and hold cash until a genuine follow-through day materializes.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price trades above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 near its 104.09 pivot with 1.63x volume, but long-term base structure lacks tight institutional contraction. Relative strength remains fragile amid severe general market distribution.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Revenue plunged 56.3% YoY with net profit declining 25.6% to ₹1.02 crore. Operating margin sits below 3% with poor 3-year ROE of 3.1% and reliance on other income. Fails CANSLIM fundamentals.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Fails below the stop trigger at ₹97.24; exit immediately without rationalizing weak turnaround hopes.

ACE.technical: Strong Stage 2 uptrend clearing a classic double bottom neckline at 1269.27 with handle resistance. MACD sits above signal and zero, holding above EMA21 and SMA50, though market weakness demands confirmed pivot volume.
ACE.fundamental: World leader in pick-and-carry cranes with 63% market share. Robust balance sheet with virtually zero net debt, healthy ROCE of 31.6%, and ROE of 22.8%, successfully passing raw material inflation to customers.
ACE.risk: Stop loss at ₹1190.67; thesis breaks if price undercuts the double bottom handle low.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Consolidation near 52-week highs above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, pressing 1861.56 pivot on 1.49x volume. Relative strength remains above average, but broader large-cap distribution exerts resistance.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Consolidated revenue grew 19% driven by an 80% international port surge and 60.4% EBITDA margin. However, high debt leverage, heavy other income, and decelerating net profit growth (+10%) dilute CANSLIM rating.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Stop at ₹1774.89; invalidate setup if price breaks the 21-EMA on institutional distribution.

AEGISLOG.technical: Classic Stage 2 leader pulling back to the rising 21-day EMA before a strong three-candle reclaim. Trades well above 50-day and 200-day moving averages with robust relative strength amid market distribution.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Exceptional CANSLIM profile; net profit surged 470% standalone to ₹394 crore with operating margins expanding to 50.3%. Strong ROE track record, expanding liquid/gas terminal capacity, and negligible leverage support sector leadership.
AEGISLOG.risk: Stop trigger at ₹1383.09; exit promptly if the 21-EMA and reversal candle low fail.

ALBERTDAVD.technical: Attempting a double bottom breakout near 932.78 on 1.54x volume, situated above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Overhead Stage 1 resistance persists, requiring volume confirmation in a hostile tape.
ALBERTDAVD.fundamental: Reported Q1 net profit of ₹32 crore (+303% YoY) on ₹101.3 crore revenue. However, earnings quality is heavily distorted by ₹28 crore of non-operating other income, while core ROCE sits below 1%.
ALBERTDAVD.risk: Hard stop at ₹878.59; thesis fails if price breaks down below the swing pivot low.

ALICON.technical: Explosive 20-day high breakout above 782.78 backed by massive 26.65x volume expansion. Trading firmly above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, demonstrating standout relative strength against a declining broader index.
ALICON.fundamental: Strong Q1 top-line acceleration (+38.3% YoY to ₹578 Cr) with order book visibility exceeding ₹8,450 Cr. Margins face transient raw material pressures, but ROCE of 11.2% and robust OEM demand support growth.
ALICON.risk: Cut losses below ₹704.98 stop if breakout bar encounters high-volume institutional rejection.
